name: taziyekart
description: TaziyeKart — cenaze evleri için beyaz etiket dijital taziye kartı

scripts.dev: npm run db:setup && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w api" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
